comparison_a_own_computation.comparison: A: own computation, DRAFTS cell-free vs Johns in-vivo, EC-BS pair (only pair with both hosts in both datasets)
comparison_a_own_computation.caveat: n is small (the DRAFTS-Johns sequence overlap is only 112 total, ~80-95 usable per pair) -- read the comparison directionally, not as a precise estimate.

b1_published_replicate_reproducibility.source: raw/drafts/msb198875_Appendix.pdf, Appendix Table S6, 'Figure 1D' rows -- TRANSCRIBED DIRECTLY, not recomputed
b1_published_replicate_reproducibility.metric: Pearson r between biological replicate 1 and replicate 2 (NOT in-vitro-vs-in-vivo)
b1_published_replicate_reproducibility.relevance: A second, independent E. coli reliability estimate via true biological replicates, comparable in spirit to Gate 8's growth-condition-based estimate (0.912/0.929) but not the same measurement -- both point to E. coli transcription reliability in the low-to-mid 0.9s.

b2_recomputed_from_drafts_own_released_d.source: data/drafts_rs234_invivo.parquet (parsed from msb198875_SourceData_Fig2.xlsx, sheet 'Appendix Fig. S5')
b2_recomputed_from_drafts_own_released_d.metric: Spearman rho, DRAFTS in-vitro (cell-free) tx vs DRAFTS in-vivo tx, same 234-sequence RS234 library, per species
b2_recomputed_from_drafts_own_released_d.note_pa_not_tested: P. aeruginosa is not in DRAFTS at all (see scripts/89); it is also not one of RS234's 7 in-vivo comparison species regardless.
